item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q017_prp8_evolutionary_mosaic","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, Prp8 is chain A of 3jb9 and is decomposed N-to-C into five domains. Four connect Prp8 to established protein lineages: d3jb9a4 (A:698–822; a.29.2.1) is in the bromodomain family; d3jb9a3 (A:823–1604; e.8.1.8) is the Prp8 reverse-transcriptase domain within the DNA/RNA-polymerase superfamily; d3jb9a2 (A:1605–1780; c.52.1.36) belongs to the restriction-endonuclease-like superfamily; and d3jb9a1 (A:1784–2030; c.55.3.14) is the Prp8 beta-finger domain within the RNase-H-like superfamily, which also contains RNases H, integrases, transposases, and resolvases. The remaining domain, d3jb9a5 (A:47–697; d.394.1.1), defines the newly observed N-terminal Prp8/Spp42 fold d.394. Thus Prp8 is an evolutionary mosaic: a novel N-terminal scaffold joined to bromodomain-, polymerase/RT-, endonuclease-, and RNase-H-like modules, consistent with ancient recruitment from mobile-element/group-II-intron-related machinery. The RT, endonuclease, and RNase-H comparisons are superfamily-level remote-homology statements, not claims that Prp8 retains the corresponding catalytic activities; only the bromodomain assignment is at the same family level. These classifications and boundaries apply directly to the five 3jb9A domains, so no representative or template classification is being transferred to another protein.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope__get_scop_service_info — /api/v1/releases/current","mcp__scope__get_scop_pdb_entry — /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/3jb9/domains","mcp__scope__get_scop_domains — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a1, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a1/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a2, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a2/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a3, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a3/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a4, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a4/parents, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a5, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3jb9a5/parents","mcp__scope__list_scop_children — /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.55.3/children?limit=100, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.52.1/children?limit=100, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/e.8.1/children?limit=100, /api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.29.2/children?limit=100"]}]}
